testcase.name: Scenario: Select templates with the secondary mouse button: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/current-document-creation-catalog-source/features/application/document-creation/document-creation-catalog-basics.feature:198:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select templates with the secondary mouse button ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders ✔> And the catalog root has no direct template files ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active with `Sketch1` visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And the template chooser shows the English folder grouped by type using Medium icons ✔ And the Part group contains Standard (in) and Sheet Metal (in) ✔ When the user right-clicks the Standard (in) part template ✔ Then Standard (in) is selected and its details show inch units ✔ And no context menu is visible ✔ When the user right-clicks the Sheet Metal (in) part template ✔ Then Sheet Metal (in) is selected and its details show inch units ✔ And no context menu is visible ✔ When the user right-clicks empty space in the Part gallery ✔ Then Sheet Metal (in) remains selected and its details remain displayed ✔ And no context menu is visible ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the chooser closes and the original part remains active
